header: HOW A PRINTED NAME IS SHOWN IN THE PAX TABLE (step 63c; my request, 31 Oct 2026): three columns, Department | Location | PAX, the first column in A to Z order, nothing about plant or outside plant. The list prints one name per line ("CISF Main Gate (IN)"), but the table needs the department and the location apart. PURE: it only reads the printed names and does not touch the database.

- Names that START WITH THE SAME WORDS share a department: the words they all begin with are the department, the rest of each name is its location (verbatim). CISF Admin Gate / CISF Main Gate (IN) / CISF Pass section(Opp Admin. Bldg.) / CISF (PCR) -> CISF | Admin Gate, Main Gate (IN), Pass section(Opp Admin. Bldg.), PCR Network Team (C & IT) / Network Team (CMMS) -> Network Team | C & IT, CMMS

- A name that stands alone is cut at its bracket: the text outside is the department, the text inside the bracket is the location. Plant Medical (PMU) -> Plant Medical | PMU; Fire Service -> Fire Service | (empty)
- A location that is only a bracket loses its brackets (A - Zone, PCR); a bracket that follows other words stays as printed (Main Gate (IN)).

- A name that stands alone but uses the SAME NUMBER as a name of a department belongs to that department, and its whole printed name is the location (my rule, 31 Oct 2026): CISF Tumla Gate and Weigh Bridge - Tumla Gate both have 42043 -> CISF | Tumla Gate and CISF | Weigh Bridge - Tumla Gate

doc: COMPLETE department names that are never cut (my words, 31 Oct 2026: "Plant Control and Plant Medical are the complete department names, can not break the words"). Without this list, the names that merely START with the same word ("Plant Control", "Plant Medical (PMU)") would be read as one department "Plant". A name that begins with one of these is that department, and the rest of the printed name (if any) is the location: Plant Medical (PMU) -> Plant Medical | PMU; Plant Control -> Plant Control | (empty). Add a name here when a department's own name begins with a word that other departments share.

doc: Sorts by department A to Z, then location, then number.

behaviours: CISF Admin Gate -> CISF | Admin Gate
CISF Main Gate (IN) -> CISF | Main Gate (IN): the bracket that follows other words stays as printed
CISF Pass section(Opp Admin. Bldg.) -> CISF | Pass section(Opp Admin. Bldg.) (no space before the bracket)
CISF (PCR) -> CISF | PCR: a location that is only a bracket loses its brackets
CISF Bhiringi main control room, CISF Gate No. 2A, CISF Tumla Gate, CISF Main Hospital
C & IT (Console) -> C & IT | Console; C & IT (DR) -> C & IT | DR
Network Team (C & IT) and (CMMS) share TWO words: Network Team | C & IT, CMMS
Civil (A - Zone) -> Civil | A - Zone
PAX Complain (In Plant) -> PAX Complain | In Plant (a place name, kept as printed)
Plant Medical (PMU) -> Plant Medical | PMU (alone: cut at the bracket)
Weigh Bridge – 60T -> Weigh Bridge | 60T (no dash left on the department, none at the start of the location)
...Gate 5(Oxy), North End, Tumla Gate likewise
...a hyphen, an em dash and a colon are separators too
...a dash INSIDE a name is kept (Gate 5 - Oxy stays as printed in a location)
a line made in the panel is shown exactly as typed
...it does not take part in the guessing: the old CISF names are grouped as before, and 'CISF (Gate 7)' keeps the department typed
...a lone old name that shares a NUMBER does not join a line made in the panel (only Telecom's own groups are joined)
toEntries gives the parts only to the lines marked as made in the panel
Plant Control is a COMPLETE department name: Plant Control | (empty), not Plant | Control
Plant Medical (PMU) is a complete name too: Plant Medical | PMU, not Plant | Medical (PMU)
...also next to other names that begin with 'Plant': the two protected names stay whole, and the other two (which only share the word) are grouped like CISF is: Plant | Garage, Plant | Water
...a word that only LOOKS like a protected name is not protected (Plant Controller, Plant Medicals)
...whatever follows a protected name is its location (Plant Control (Telecom) -> Telecom; Plant Control Room -> Room)
MRS Control (Electrical Complain) -> MRS Control | Electrical Complain
Fire Service -> Fire Service | (empty)
Weigh Bridge - Tumla Gate uses 42043 like CISF Tumla Gate -> CISF | Weigh Bridge - Tumla Gate
...without that shared number it stands alone (no guessing from the words)
...two names that stand alone and share a number stay apart (neither is a department of the other)
case and double spaces do not matter
the same name twice is one entry; an empty name is dropped
A to Z by department, then location, then number (two lines of one place keep a stable order)
